title: Robotics Engineer
description: Design autonomous robots, kinematics, sensor fusion, SLAM algorithms, motor control, and simulation using ROS 2, C++, and Python.

goal.objective: Program physical and simulated robotic systems capable of autonomous navigation, perception, manipulation, and real-time control.

learn.summary: Master ROS 2 (Robot Operating System), nodes, topics, actions, Gazebo physics simulation, forward/inverse kinematics, SLAM, Nav2 navigation stack, and sensor fusion.
key_competencies: Robot Simulation in Gazebo & URDF Modeling
Nav2 Autonomous Path Planning & Obstacle Avoidance
Sensor Fusion with Kalman Filters (LiDAR, IMU)
prerequisites: Linear algebra, vector calculus and physics mechanics

capstone_projects.title: Autonomous Mobile Robot (AMR) SLAM & Nav2 Stack in ROS 2
capstone_projects.description: Build an autonomous warehouse robot simulation in Gazebo featuring real-time 2D LiDAR SLAM, dynamic costmaps, obstacle avoidance, and path planning via Nav2.

capstone_projects.title: 6-DOF Robotic Arm Inverse Kinematics & Trajectory Controller
capstone_projects.description: Develop an automated pick-and-place manipulation pipeline using MoveIt 2, computing forward and inverse kinematics, trajectory optimization, and computer vision.

interview_focus: ROS 2 Computational Graph (Nodes, Topics, Services, Actions, Quality of Service / QoS Profiles)
Kinematics & Dynamics (Denavit-Hartenberg Parameters, Forward vs Inverse Kinematics, Jacobians)
Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) & Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) Sensor Fusion
Path Planning Algorithms (A*, Dijkstra, Rapidly-exploring Random Trees / RRT*, D* Lite)
Coordinate Transformations in Robotics (Quaternions, Rotation Matrices, TF2 in ROS 2)

tree.name: Core Foundations for Robotics
tree.description: Master foundational mathematics, rigid body mechanics, spatial kinematics, and systems programming for robotics engineering.

resources.title: Robotics 101: Introduction to Robotics | Kinematics & Modeling | Full course for beginners (Engineering Simplified)

children.name: Programming Essentials for Robotics
children.description: Master robotics software development in Python and modern C++ (C++17/20): Memory management, real-time performance, and multi-threading.

children.name: Python for Robotics & Scripting
children.description: Utilize Python for robotics: NumPy for vectorized matrix operations, SciPy spatial transforms, Matplotlib for kinematic plotting, and OpenCV for vision.

resources.title: Automate the Boring Stuff with Python

children.name: C++ for High-Performance Robotics
children.description: Program high-performance C++ for robotics: RAII, smart pointers, Eigen linear algebra library, multithreading with `std::thread`, and low-latency execution.

resources.title: C++ Crash Course by John L. Vandevoorde
Effective Modern C++ by Scott Meyers

children.name: Data Structures & Algorithms
children.description: Implement robotics algorithms: Graph search (BFS, DFS, Dijkstra, A*), spatial indexing (k-d trees, octrees), and priority queues for planning.

resources.title: Robotics 101: Introduction to Robotics | Kinematics & Modeling | Full course for beginners (Engineering Simplified)

children.name: Version Control & Collaboration (Git)
children.description: Manage robotics codebases: Git branching, submodule management for multi-package ROS workspaces, and continuous integration testing.

children.name: Mathematical Foundations for Robotics
children.description: Master the mathematics of robotic systems: Linear algebra, multivariable calculus, Lie groups, quaternions, and probability theory.

children.name: Linear Algebra for Robotics
children.description: Master spatial transformations: Homogeneous transformation matrices (SE(3)), rotation matrices (SO(3)), Euler angles, quaternions, and eigenvalue decomposition.

children.name: Calculus & Optimization for Robotics
children.description: Apply optimization in robotics: Gradient descent, non-linear least squares, Lagrange multipliers, and convex optimization for trajectory planning.

resources.title: Robotics 101: Introduction to Robotics | Kinematics & Modeling | Full course for beginners (Engineering Simplified)

children.name: Probability & Statistics for Robotics
children.description: Model sensor uncertainty: Gaussian distributions, covariance matrices, Bayesian estimation, and probabilistic state estimation.

resources.title: Stanford Online: Introduction to Probability and Statistics
Probabilistic Robotics by Thrun, Burgard, Fox

children.name: Physics & Mechanics Intuition
children.description: Understand rigid body mechanics: Newton-Euler equations, Lagrangian mechanics, centers of mass, inertia tensors, and torque calculations.

children.name: Electronics & Control Hardware Basics
children.description: Interface with robot electronics: Motor drivers (H-bridges, BLDC ESCs), rotary encoders, microcontrollers, CAN bus, and power distribution.

tree.name: Robotics Core Concepts
tree.description: Master kinematics, dynamics, actuation, and control systems for mobile robots and multi-axis manipulator arms.

resources.title: Robotics 101: Introduction to Robotics | Kinematics & Modeling | Full course for beginners (Engineering Simplified)

children.name: Robot Kinematics
children.description: Compute robot kinematics: Forward kinematics with Denavit-Hartenberg (DH) parameters, inverse kinematics (analytical and numerical Jacobian pseudo-inverse), and differential kinematics.

children.name: Robot Dynamics
children.description: Model robot dynamics: Forward and inverse dynamics, Coriolis forces, gravity compensation, and joint torque computation using Recursive Newton-Euler Algorithm (RNEA).

children.name: Control Systems Design
children.description: Design robotic control architectures: Open-loop vs closed-loop systems, frequency response, stability criteria, and feedback linearization.

children.name: PID Control
children.description: Tune PID controllers: Proportional-Integral-Derivative gain tuning, anti-windup mechanisms, derivative filtering, and cascaded velocity/position control loops.

resources.title: Robotics 101: Introduction to Robotics | Kinematics & Modeling | Full course for beginners (Engineering Simplified)

children.name: State-Space Control
children.description: Implement state-space control: Linear Quadratic Regulators (LQR), Model Predictive Control (MPC), and state observers (Luenberger observers).

children.name: Robot Actuation & Drivetrains
children.description: Analyze drivetrains: Differential drive, Ackermann steering, omnidirectional Mecanum wheels, harmonic drives, planetary gearboxes, and BLDC motor selection.

tree.name: ROS 2 and Simulation
tree.description: Master Robot Operating System 2 (ROS 2) and physics-based simulation environments (Gazebo, Ignition).

children.name: ROS 2 Fundamentals
children.description: Master ROS 2 architecture: DDS (Data Distribution Service) middleware, ROS 2 nodes, workspaces (`colcon build`), package structures, and lifecycle nodes.

resources.title: Robotics 101: Introduction to Robotics | Kinematics & Modeling | Full course for beginners (Engineering Simplified)

children.name: ROS 2 Communication Patterns
children.description: Implement ROS 2 communication: Asynchronous Topics (publish/subscribe), synchronous Services (request/response), and long-running preemptible Actions.

children.name: ROS 2 Tools & Debugging
children.description: Utilize ROS 2 diagnostic tools: Rviz2 for 3D visualization, rqt plugins, recording/playing sensor telemetry with ros2 bag, and `tf2` coordinate frame transform trees.

children.name: Robot Modeling & Advanced Simulation
children.description: Model robot physics: Defining kinematic trees in URDF (Unified Robot Description Format) and XACRO macros, collision meshes, and inertia properties.

children.name: Robot Description (URDF/XACRO)
children.description: Author modular robot descriptions: Joint types (revolute, continuous, prismatic), transmission tags, and parameterizing models with Xacro.

resources.title: Robotics 101: Introduction to Robotics | Kinematics & Modeling | Full course for beginners (Engineering Simplified)

children.name: Simulation Environments (Gazebo/Ignition)
children.description: Simulate robots in Gazebo / Ignition: World files, physics engines (ODE, Bullet), friction models, sensor plugins (LiDAR, RGB-D cameras), and gravity.

children.name: Simulation Plugins & Customization
children.description: Write custom Gazebo plugins: Developing C++ Gazebo sensor and model plugins to simulate custom actuators, encoders, and environmental interactions.

children.name: ROS 2 Security & Best Practices
children.description: Secure ROS 2 deployments: SROS 2 (Secure ROS 2) utilizing DDS-Security specifications for authentication, access control, and encrypted network communications.

tree.name: Perception for Robotics
tree.description: Process multimodal sensor streams: 2D computer vision, 3D point clouds, and sensor fusion for environment perception.

resources.title: Multiple View Geometry in Computer Vision by Hartley & Zisserman
Robotics 101: Introduction to Robotics | Kinematics & Modeling | Full course for beginners (Engineering Simplified)

children.name: Sensors for Robotics
children.description: Integrate robotic sensors: 2D/3D LiDAR, stereoscopic cameras, depth cameras (Intel RealSense), IMUs (accelerometer + gyroscope), wheel encoders, and GPS/GNSS.

resources.title: Sensor Fusion and Perception (NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute)

children.name: Computer Vision Fundamentals for Robotics
children.description: Implement visual processing: Camera calibration, OpenCV image filtering, feature extraction, visual odometry, and fiducial marker tracking (AprilTags, ArUco).

resources.title: Computer Vision: Algorithms and Applications by Richard Szeliski

children.name: Point Cloud Processing (3D Perception)
children.description: Process 3D point clouds with PCL (Point Cloud Library) and Open3D: Voxel grid downsampling, pass-through filtering, RANSAC plane segmentation, and Euclidean clustering.

children.name: Sensor Fusion for Perception
children.description: Implement sensor fusion: Extended Kalman Filters (EKF), Unscented Kalman Filters (UKF), and fusing IMU with wheel odometry using `robot_localization`.

resources.title: Probabilistic Robotics by Thrun, Burgard, Fox (Sensor Fusion chapters)
Robotics 101: Introduction to Robotics | Kinematics & Modeling | Full course for beginners (Engineering Simplified)

children.name: Deep Learning for Robotic Perception
children.description: Deploy deep learning models in robotics: Real-time object detection (YOLO), semantic segmentation, and 3D bounding box estimation running on NVIDIA Jetson with TensorRT.

resources.title: Deep Learning for Computer Vision (Stanford CS231n)

tree.name: Navigation & Control for Autonomous Robots
tree.description: Master autonomous navigation: Mapping, Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM), global/local path planning, and obstacle avoidance.

resources.title: Probabilistic Robotics by Thrun, Burgard, Fox

children.name: Mapping Techniques for Robotics
children.description: Construct environment maps: 2D occupancy grid maps, 3D Octomaps, costmaps (global/local costmap layers), and inflation radii.

children.name: Localization & SLAM Algorithms
children.description: Execute SLAM algorithms: Particle filter localization (AMCL), 2D LiDAR SLAM (Cartographer, SLAM Toolbox), and Visual SLAM (RTAB-Map, ORB-SLAM3).

resources.title: ORB-SLAM3: An accurate open-source library for Visual, Visual-Inertial and Multi-Map SLAM
Robotics 101: Introduction to Robotics | Kinematics & Modeling | Full course for beginners (Engineering Simplified)

children.name: Global & Local Path Planning
children.description: Plan collision-free paths: Global planners (A*, Dijkstra, RRT / RRT*), and local trajectory planners (Dynamic Window Approach - DWA, TEB Local Planner).

resources.title: Planning Algorithms by Steven M. LaValle

children.name: Trajectory Generation & Execution
children.description: Generate smooth trajectories: Polynomial trajectory generation, minimum jerk/snap trajectories, spline interpolation, and collision-checking.

resources.title: Robot Trajectory Planning: A Tutorial Review

children.name: Behavior Planning & Decision Making
children.description: Model robotic decision-making: Behavior Trees (BehaviorTree.CPP), Finite State Machines (FSM), and hierarchical task networks.

resources.title: Behavior Trees for AI in Robotics and Games (Book)

children.name: ROS 2 Navigation Stack (Nav2)
children.description: Master the ROS 2 Navigation Stack (Nav2): Waypoint following, custom costmap plugins, recovery behaviors, behavior tree navigators, and multi-robot fleets.

resources.title: Robotics 101: Introduction to Robotics | Kinematics & Modeling | Full course for beginners (Engineering Simplified)

tree.name: Hardware Integration and Deployment
tree.description: Integrate physical hardware, calibrate sensors, implement real-time motor control, and enforce hardware safety.

children.name: Sensor & Actuator Integration
children.description: Wire and interface physical hardware: High-power motor drivers, relay circuits, emergency stop (E-stop) hardware buttons, and CAN bus transceivers.

children.name: Sensor Calibration & Synchronization
children.description: Calibrate and synchronize sensors: Camera-to-LiDAR extrinsic calibration, IMU noise modeling (Allan variance), and hardware PPS (Pulse Per Second) time synchronization.

children.name: Hardware Drivers & Interfaces for ROS 2
children.description: Develop ROS 2 hardware drivers: Writing C++ ROS 2 nodes to interface with serial devices, USB cameras (v4l2), and micro-ROS on microcontrollers.

resources.title: Manufacturer Datasheets & SDKs (examples from RealSense, Velodyne, etc.)
Robotics 101: Introduction to Robotics | Kinematics & Modeling | Full course for beginners (Engineering Simplified)

children.name: ROS 2 Control Framework
children.description: Implement `ros2_control`: Writing hardware interfaces (SystemInterface), joint state broad-casters, effort/velocity/position controllers, and transmission interfaces.

children.name: Real-world Testing & Safety
children.description: Conduct hardware field tests: Staged testing (simulation -> bench test -> tethered run -> autonomous field run), battery management, and thermal monitoring.

resources.title: Robot Operating System (ROS) in Real-Time (Ch. 12: Real-World Robot Development)
Best Practices for Robotics System Deployment (Intel)

children.name: Experiment Design & Data Analysis
children.description: Benchmark robotic performance: Tracking trajectory tracking error, localization drift over time, compute load, and plotting benchmark curves in Foxglove Studio.

children.name: Robot Safety & Ethical Considerations
children.description: Comply with robotic safety standards: ISO 10218 / ISO 13849 safety requirements for industrial robots, collaborative robot (cobot) force limits, and failsafe states.

resources.title: IEEE Global Initiative on Ethics of Autonomous and Intelligent Systems
Robotics 101: Introduction to Robotics | Kinematics & Modeling | Full course for beginners (Engineering Simplified)

tree.name: Advanced Robotics Topics & Specializations
tree.description: Explore specialized robotics domains: Reinforcement learning in robotics, manipulation, field robotics, and cloud robotics.

resources.title: Robotics & AI Research Papers (e.g., ICRA, IROS)

children.name: Machine Learning for Robotics
children.description: Apply machine learning in robotics: Reinforcement learning for locomotion in Isaac Gym, imitation learning for manipulation, and domain randomization for Sim-to-Real transfer.

resources.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Robotics (UC Berkeley)

children.name: Human-Robot Interaction (HRI)
children.description: Design Human-Robot Interaction: Social navigation, intent prediction, safe collaborative workspaces, and multimodal user interfaces (voice, gesture).

children.name: Field Robotics & Autonomous Systems
children.description: Deploy field robots: Agricultural robots, autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs), unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs / PX4 Autopilot), and rough terrain traversal.

resources.title: Robotics 101: Introduction to Robotics | Kinematics & Modeling | Full course for beginners (Engineering Simplified)

children.description: Architect cloud robotics: Offloading heavy mapping to cloud clusters, edge computing on NVIDIA Jetson, and fleet management with AWS RoboMaker / Formant.

resources.title: Edge AI and Robotics: The Future of Automation
